description: This file provides a wrapper for system setjmp/longjmp or compiler try/catch mechanisms, including signal handling for SIGBUS and platform-specific exception handling.

methods.name: sys_setjmp_sigbus
methods.description: Handles SIGBUS signal, performs longjmp or siglongjmp based on platform.

methods.name: sys_setjmp_eval3
methods.description: Executes a callback with setjmp/longjmp protection, handling exceptions and signals.
